treatment_chemistry: P/N/B intumescent flame retardant synthesized from phytic acid, boric acid, pentaerythritol and urea
treatment_method: dip in IFR solution (liquor ratio 1:25), 60 °C for 30 min; pad to 100±5% wet pickup; predry and cure at 160 °C for 3 min; rinse and air dry
evidence: Open-access Materials 2022 article. Table 1 gives exact N2 TGA values; text gives exact LOI values. Material section specifies 80/20 PET/cotton, 94 g/m², commercial textile source. The paper does not state TGA heating rate, so that field is intentionally blank.
source_title: Fabrication of P/N/B-Based Intumescent Flame-Retardant Coating for Polyester/Cotton Blend Fabric
limitations: TGA heating rate and gas flow were not specified in the article. T/C-1 at 200 g/L is textually associated with 13.7% weight gain; T/C-2 weight gain is graphical only and is left blank.
